GAP_ANALYSIS_AMENDMENT: Additional acceptance criteria from gap analysis:

- Given caller passes both --data '{"foo":"bar"}' and --degradation-type inferred_decision, When script runs, Then data JSON contains BOTH foo:bar AND degradation_type:"inferred_decision" (merge, not overwrite) — tests the core DD2 backwards-compat risk
- Given --degradation-type is provided WITHOUT --degradation flag (or vice versa), When script runs, Then behavior must be defined: either both required together OR each is independent — pin this contract in the RED test before T2 implements it
